ranking_note: Authored from the before descriptions at commit fd862a49b848e143ec31bebc054c01d31150a26a, frozen before the rewrite; protocol per /playbooks:skill-authoring ## Measurement. Competitors are improvement:find (a ranked list of options, never edits), code-tidying:tidy (structure-only lane hunt), debugging:debug (an observed failure), architecture:improve (module-level friction and a redesign interview), docs-hygiene:compress (shortening markdown without meaning loss), naming:name-it-better (fresh name candidates) and performance:go-faster (speed of the development process). improve owns finding one gap in a named target against written standards or current upstream guidance and shipping it as one small PR.
